## Checklist

- [ ] Catalog entries link to the primary source and state license and runtime requirements.
- [ ] Tables stay pipe-aligned (`npx --yes awesome-lint` passes).
- [ ] Skill changes keep `name` equal to the folder name and update `evals/triggers/<skill>.json` when the trigger scope changes.
- [ ] New images in `assets/` have a `.vis.provenance.json` sidecar.
- [ ] No private local paths, keys, or tokens.
